**Price**

NE301 is available in three variants with different pricing: NE301 Wi-Fi at **$199.90**, NE301 LTE Cat.1 at **$251.00**, and NE301 PoE at **$258.00** [2][8]. The overall price range across variants is **$199.90–$258.00** [5]. Volume pricing is available for larger quantities [1].

**How to Order**

You can purchase NE301 directly online from the CamThink store for the Wi-Fi and PoE versions [4][8]. The LTE Cat.1 version is also listed on the product page [2]. For volume orders, custom configurations, or the USB-C version (required for solar power kits), contact **sales@camthink.ai** [4][10]. A tailored quote can be arranged based on your target use cases [1].

**Shipping**

The available materials do not specify standard shipping options or delivery times. The only shipping-related note is that orders containing the solar power kit may require a longer delivery time than standard orders [10]. For shipping details, contact the CamThink store.
